File Information
Collection: WoTA Term Project (Co-working Space Reservation)
Collection Description
2110503 Software Development Practice term project, group WOTA. Runs top to bottom in Postman Runner or Newman (`newman run WoTA_TermProject.postman_collection.json`). Every run registers fresh users and rooms, so it can be repeated. Set the URL collection variable to your server (default http://localhost:5000). FR1-FR9 are the functional requirements of Project #6; A1-A13 are the additional requirements claimed as extra credits. Folder 11 checks that the original VacQ APIs from Assignment 7 (hospitals and appointments) still work.
